_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for North Korea (DPRK) covering ancient Gojoseon, Three Kingdoms (Goguryeo), Unified Silla, Goryeo, Joseon Dynasty, Japanese colonization 1910-1945, post-WWII Soviet occupation zone, Kim Il Sung's Korean War (1950-53, ceasefire only), Juche ideology, totalitarian state, famine 1990s, nuclear weapons program (2006+ tests), hereditary dictatorship (Kim dynasty), cult of personality, and extreme isolation.

country_profile.government_type: Unitary one-party totalitarian Juche socialist republic

population.source: UN estimate (DPRK does not release reliable data)

gdp.source: CIA World Factbook (last estimate, highly uncertain)

religion.note: Officially atheist state; religion brutally suppressed; Juche ideology (Kim Il Sung's self-reliance philosophy) is quasi-religious state cult; Kim family worshipped; Songbun (songbun) caste system based on family background; underground Christianity persecuted

ethnic_groups.name: Korean
ethnic_groups.notes: Ethnically homogeneous; totalitarian state enforces extreme nationalism; 'pure blood' ideology; Han Chinese small minority (mostly traders at border); hermit kingdom

independence.from: Declared independence from Soviet/US occupation zones after WWII Japanese colonial rule ended; separate from South Korea

country_profile.notes_unique: Most isolated/totalitarian state globally; nuclear weapons state (6 tests 2006-2017); ICBMs; Juche ideology; hereditary dictatorship (Kim dynasty, 3 generations); Korean War (1950-53, ~3M dead, technically still at war - armistice only); 1990s famine ('Arduous March', ~1M dead); gulags (kwanliso camps, ~120,000 prisoners); no internet (Kwangmyong intranet only); propaganda/personality cult; Ryugyong Hotel (tallest unoccupied building globally, 1987-incomplete)

trade.notes: UN sanctions crippled trade; China 90%+ of trade; illicit trade (weapons, counterfeiting, cyber theft generating $1B+/year); coal/textiles exports banned; ship-to-ship smuggling.

infrastructure.notes: Decrepit Soviet-era infrastructure; no public internet (Kwangmyong intranet only); chronic power cuts; rail-dependent transport; 3% road paving; satellite imagery shows dark at night.

governance_indices.notes: Kim Jong-un totalitarian dictatorship; Juche ideology; personality cult; worst human rights record globally (UN COI); zero civil liberties; hermit kingdom.

geography.terrain: Mountainous interior; narrow coastal plains east and west; Kaema Plateau
geography.notes: Heavily militarized; DMZ divides Korean Peninsula; Paektu Mountain sacred/mythological significance; mineral-rich; nuclear weapons state; most isolated country globally.

economy_extended.notes: Command economy; sanctions-isolated; chronic food insecurity; nuclear/missile program consumes resources; Kaesong SEZ closed; illicit activities (counterfeiting, cyber theft, arms).

health.notes: Data unreliable (state-reported); nominally free healthcare; medicine shortages severe; world's highest TB incidence; malnutrition widespread; no COVID-19 admitted until 2022.

food_agriculture.notes: Chronic food insecurity; 1990s famine killed 600k-3M; agricultural collectivization; limited fuel/fertilizer; 40%+ population food insecure (WFP); mountainous terrain limits arable land.

security_stability.border_disputes: DMZ with South Korea; Northern Limit Line
security_stability.notes: Nuclear weapons state (est. 40-50 warheads); ICBMs; world's 4th largest military; 200K+ political prisoners; Kim dynasty totalitarian control; arms exports to Russia.

environment_climate.notes: Severe deforestation for fuel/agriculture; flooding exacerbated by deforestation; energy crisis (biomass dependence); nuclear test site environmental contamination; DMZ biodiversity corridor.

demographics_extended.notes: Ethnically homogeneous; data extremely limited; songbun (social classification system); forced labor mobilization; defectors ~34,000 (to South Korea); population declining.

comparative_rankings._note: Country position relative to continent and global.
comparative_rankings.notes: Most isolated country; nuclear-armed; Juche ideology; Kim dynasty since 1948; heavily sanctioned.

major_festivals: Day of the Sun (Kim Il-sung birthday, 15 April)
Day of the Shining Star (Kim Jong-il birthday, 16 Feb)
cuisine_highlights: injo gogi bap (rice with artificial meat)
cultural_heritage.media_landscape: Rodong Sinmun (party newspaper); KCNA (state news); KCTV; no independent media; total state control.
cultural_heritage.notes: Juche (self-reliance) ideology; Kim personality cult; Mass Games spectacle; Koguryo kingdom heritage; DMZ tourism.

energy.notes: Coal and hydropower dominant; frequent blackouts; Pyongyang prioritized; oil from China (pipeline); nuclear weapons program but no civilian nuclear power; deforestation for fuel.

human_rights_gender.lgbtq_legal_status: State claims 'does not exist'; de facto persecution
human_rights_gender.notes: Among worst human rights records globally; UN COI found crimes against humanity (2014); political prison camps (kwan-li-so, est. 80,000–120,000 inmates); no freedom of press, religion, movement, assembly.

legal_system.legal_tradition: Socialist civil law; Juche legal theory
legal_system.notes: Judicature subordinate to Korean Workers' Party; Central Court; no rule of law in Western sense; songbun (political caste system) governs citizen status; extra-judicial enforcement.

tourism.notes: Extremely restricted tourism; guided tours only; Koryo Tours (Beijing-based) main operator; closed since COVID-19 (2020); US citizens banned since 2017 (Otto Warmbier).

transport.notes: Pyongyang Metro (one of deepest in world, 100m); rail-dependent (colonial-era Japanese infrastructure); extremely limited private car ownership; Air Koryo (national airline).

current_leader.name: Kim Jong Un
current_leader.title: Supreme Leader (General Secretary of WPK, President of State Affairs Commission, Supreme Commander of Armed Forces)
current_leader.notes: Third-generation hereditary dictator; grandson of Kim Il Sung; purged uncle Jang Song-thaek (2013); possibly killed half-brother Kim Jong-nam (2017 assassination Malaysia); nuclear/ICBM tests; summits with Trump (2018-19); COVID-19 hermit seal; sister Kim Yo-jong key aide

former_leaders.name: Kim Jong Il
former_leaders.notes: 'Dear Leader'; son of Kim Il Sung; cult of personality; Songun (military-first) policy; 1990s famine; collapsed economy; nuclear program; second-generation dictator; died of heart attack on train

former_leaders.name: Kim Il Sung
former_leaders.notes: 'Eternal President'; founded DPRK; Korean War (invaded South 1950); totalitarian state builder; Juche ideology; extreme personality cult ('Sun of the Nation'); massive statues/portraits mandatory; continues to be 'president' posthumously
